description: Close an open position (fully or partially). Pass `unitsToDeduct` to close only part of the position; omit it to close fully.

instrumentId.description: Instrument ID of the position (optional; will be looked up from portfolio if omitted)

unitsToDeduct.description: Number of units to close for partial close. Omit for full close.

name: etoro_close_position
title: Close position
